name: Aria ~ After World
source:
This game and "Nana ~ After world" are both sequels for the previous game "Remember Death". This one follows the story of Kotaro who decided to save Aria and go back to stop a virus that is going to infect the world.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639966]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
本游戏和《娜娜～After world》都是前作《Remember Death》的续作。该剧讲述了小太郎决定拯救阿莉亚并回去阻止即将感染世界的病毒的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639966]Newgrounds[/url]]
